description.value: At 1st level, a gunner gains one of the following firearms of his choice: trainee pistol, trainee rifle or trainee shotgun. His starting weapon is battered, and only he knows how to use it properly. All other creatures treat his gun as if it had the broken condition. If the weapon already has the broken condition, it does not work at all for anyone else trying to use it. This starting weapon can only be sold for scrap (it's worth 4d10 gil when sold). The gunner also gains Gunsmithing as a bonus feat. At 5th level and every four gunner levels thereafter (9th, 13th, 17th), a gunner can reconfigure his firearm with a single modification by spending 1 hour of work. Most modifications can only be taken once, unless specified. He may reconfigure his firearm as many times as he likes but is only granted up to 4 (at 17th level) of the following benefits at a time. The gunner can only modify 1 gun at a time, to a maximum allowed by this feature per gun (at 17th level, he can put 4 mods onto any number of guns). He can deconstruct modifications from his current gun by spending 1 hour of work but loses the modification and any gil spent towards it. Available modifications include Adamantine Barrel, Clearing Mechanism, Cannon Bore, Canted Ironsights, Comfort Grip, Compensator, Dual-Balanced, Elongated Barrel, Exotic Metal Barrel, Greater Ammo Capacity, Heavy Barrel, Huge Bore, Large Bore, Molybdenum Barrel, Muzzle Brake, Night Vision, Potato Grip, Reflex Sight, Rifled Bore, Spring-Loaded Cylinder, and Tactically Adapted, each with its own cost and level prerequisite.
